sources.title: Jonathan Levin, Auction Theory
sources.document_version: October 2004, actual physical/printed page1; thirteen-page PDF.
sources.actual_body_scope: Fresh official web and local body inspection of physical/printed1–7, especially first-price derivation3–4 and revenue equivalence5–7. Adjacent common-value opening8 was encountered but is not relied upon. Pages9–13 are outside this task’s used scope.
sources.supported_use: IPV information assumptions, first/second-price rules, equilibrium bid derivation, interim revenue identity and all-pay construction.
limits: First-price sufficiency/global deviations are referred elsewhere in the source; original power-distribution examples will prove them over the entire nonnegative bid domain.

Physical/printed6 first correctly derives P(v)=integral t dG(t), then incorrectly equates that interim payment to a conditional order-statistic expectation without multiplying by G(v). The actual page image confirms the missing winning-probability factor; use P(v)=G(v) E[payment | win,v].
No general uniqueness, affiliated/common-value revenue ranking, clock equivalence or large-auction aggregation theorem is imported.

sources.title: Asu Ozdaglar, 6.254 Lecture20: Mechanism Design II
sources.document_version: May4,2010 on actual cover; MIT Spring2010 course. Physical pages equal slide numbers through20; page21 is OCW notice.
sources.actual_body_scope: Cover1 and body2–20 read locally. Relied-on scope4–12 for mechanism/DS revelation/Groves/Clarke, and18–19 for conditional BNE/BIC and Bayesian revelation. Sections13–17 and20 were read only to exclude broader uniqueness, impossibility and dAGV claims.
sources.supported_use: Direct and indirect mechanisms, selected-equilibrium implementation, dominant versus conditional Bayesian incentive inequalities, and Groves welfare-comparison proof.
limits: Transfers in the slides flow TO the agent; chapter payments flow FROM the agent. Reverse signs consistently and include the designer’s known resource cost once.
Both revelation results are stated, not fully proved by strategy composition. Supply pure and independently randomized strategy-simulation proofs, with commitment and measurable integrable payoffs.

Do not import a general Groves-necessity/Green–Laffont budget impossibility/dAGV theorem. The proposed project deficit is an exact counterexample to automatic self-financing, not a proof of every-mechanism impossibility. Pivot IR requires a separately stated feasible-removal/nonnegative-value embedding.

sources.title: Tim Roughgarden, CS364A Lecture5: Revenue-Maximizing Auctions
sources.document_version: October7,2013 on actual first page; eight-page document.
sources.actual_body_scope: All eight physical/printed pages read as text. Relied-on sections1.3/1.4,2 and3.1: independent distributions, virtual-revenue derivation, regular single-item pointwise maximization. Section3.2 read to mark unproved extensions.
sources.supported_use: Known independent private-value distributions; expected virtual surplus; monotone regular virtual allocation and reserve interpretation.
limits: Web PDF open failed; HTTPS retrieval succeeded and actual local body/images were inspected. Retrieval failure is not misrepresented as body reading.

Physical4 uses derivatives for payments and leaves nonsmooth justification to the reader. Reuse/rederive the C08 pairwise integral-envelope argument, including jumps and the boundary-utility constant.

Physical8 states optimality against all BIC mechanisms without proving it. Supply the independent interim envelope plus feasible pointwise virtual upper bound to prove this extension in the declared single-item class.
No irregular ironing, named-family regularity catalogue, multi-parameter optimal auction, computational-complexity or real-platform practice claim is adopted.

original_work: All six numerical cases, twelve exercise transfers, cash accounts and proof completions are original instructional constructions. Sources supply scoped method routes, not these quantities or evidence of observed auction behavior.
runtime_boundary: Only canonical chapter HTML/checker/source/author JSON are runtime files; preparation, blueprint and retained PDF/text/images are provenance, never runtime dependencies.
excluded_claims: Unique/full implementation; universal budget-balance impossibility; Groves necessity
General irregular ironing or multi-object revenue optimality
Solved risk-averse first-price equilibrium or its revenue ranking
Current platform/legal practice or empirical identification from bids alone
